content:
katie: heads-up — I ran the nightly docs link-scan against main. found a small cluster that looks quick to patch, mostly stale image links and a few dead anchors in runtime guides. posting a short list and asking for dibs

katie: command I ran
```
$ yarn docs:link-scan --since=2026-03-20 --format=summary
```

docs-bot: scan complete — summary: 21 image 403s, 7 dead anchors, 3 staging-404s. full report saved to /tmp/scan-8432109999.json (private).

katie: top priorities: runtime guide (kv-cache.md anchors), onboarding/quickstart images (curl snippets), and a weird css asset referenced from handbook. paths below are the ones that block small UXs
- docs/runtime/kv-cache.md#prefetching (dead anchor)
- docs/runtime/kv-cache.md#cache-eviction (dead anchor)
- docs/runtime/batching.md (screenshot ./assets/batching-1.png -> 403)
- docs/onboarding/curl-examples.md (screenshot ./assets/curl-1.png -> 403)
- docs/handbook/branding.md (external css shortlink -> 403)

katie: can folks claim specific files so we don't duplicate fixes? if you take one, ping here with PR when ready. ideally small PRs directly to main with CI green. :slightly_smiling_face: @alex @maria

alex: I can take the kv-cache anchors. will grep the file and add heading ids + small note. aim to open PR today.

sam: can you drop the list of exact anchor names? want to confirm we don't break redirects into other internal links.

katie: sure — anchors missing are
- "prefetching"
- "cache-eviction"
I'll add a short comment in the report about redirects, but feel free to run local linkcheck after changes:
```
$ mkdocs build && linkcheck site/_site
```

maria: i'll handle the onboarding curl images. suspect they're S3 permission flips; if rehosting to our CDN is needed I can do that & update paths. prefer a small PR to main with rehosted assets.

jordan: branding.md — iirc that shortlink is from a partner we shouldn't hotlink. i'll replace with archived copy and add a note citing the partner.

katie: perfect — thanks. once PRs are open drop the links here and I'll queue reviewers (docs-sherpa team). also putting ticket KB-278 in the PR body for tracking.

alex: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1421 (fixes anchors + a tiny grammar tweak). cc @katie

maria: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1422 (rehosted images under /static/assets/onboarding/ and updated paths)

jordan: PR draft -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1423 (archived css + note). will mark ready after CI run.

sam: quick question — do we want a post-merge sweep to check for similar shortlink patterns? could add a small GH action or add to nightly scan for that prefix.

katie: yes, good call. filing a follow-up: will propose a tiny GH action that flags shortlinks to 3rd-party css/js. I'll share the proposal in #eng-automation later today.

maria: LGTM, will add tests for image presence in the PR.

katie: thanks all — I'll close the loop after merges and update the KB ticket. :thumbsup:
